text:
lucas: Heads-up: AP-SOUTH GPU pool stalled during onboarding. Kubelets failing to decrypt node secrets, KMS 403s after the VPCE tighten this morning.
irene: Logs?
lucas: snippet from keystore sidecar on gpu-ap-ctl-2:
```
2026-03-23T13:05:12Z ERROR keystore: AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:ap-south-1:111:key/aa11-bb22
node: gpu-ap-ctl-2
```
lucas: Keystore calls regional grant broker over a VPC endpoint. The new endpoint policy added a default-deny and a deny for broad privatelink principals. Seems to have shadowed the keystore allow.
ops-bot: alert: keystore.kms.decrypt denied x 61 in 5m  https://ops/redwood/alerts/keystore-ap-kms-403
mukesh: That matches the spike we saw. We intentionally tightened to stop wide audit egress, but forgot the keystore principal exception.
irene: What's the fastest safe mitigation?
oncall-sre: Two options: (A) rollback the VPCE policy (fastest), (B) create a short-lived KMS grant + patch VPCE policy to add an explicit Allow for the keystore principal (preferred for least blast radius).
mukesh: We should avoid rollback if possible. Approve emergency grant for 3h TTL. Keep change minimal.
lucas: Proposed grant CLI:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/keystore-aps --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111:role/keystore-privatelink --operations Decrypt --name "ap-onboard-temp"
```
lucas: Minimal VPCE change: add single Allow statement scoped to the keystore role and to kms:Decrypt on keystore-keys/prefix. Will deploy canary to ap-south-1a.
mukesh: Also, add an explicit condition on SourceVpc or Principal tag to reduce risk.
oncall-sre: I'll add synthetic checks: keystore.Decrypt + node kubelet readiness. If >25% nodes still failing after 12 minutes, we rollback.
ops-bot: deploy request created by mukesh  https://deploy/redwood/8721
lucas: Grant created id g-0xaffec0de. Testing canary node now.
lucas: Canary decrypted and joined, kubelet Ready. :white_check_mark:
mukesh: Applying VPCE policy patch for canary AZ. Grant TTL set to 3h.
irene: Quick note for cost/product: if we mirror audit logs regionally to avoid tight VPCE denies, estimate is ~USD 120/day for extra S3 storage+requests in ap-south. Filing as follow-up item.
mukesh: Add to audit-hardening PR. We prefer log retention over blocking onboarding.
oncall-sre: Monitoring started 13:25. Current recovery: 11/14 previously pending nodes recovered after grant+policy patch. Escalate to rollback if we hit the threshold.
lucas: I'll draft a short postmortem + minimal policy snippet for the keystore path to include in the PR. Also adding a privatelink CI test to detect denies that shadow specific allows.
mukesh: Good. Also confirm CloudTrail entries for the temporary grant and the VPCE change for audit.
ops-bot: alert still open, awaiting human close  https://ops/redwood/alerts/keystore-ap-kms-403
